think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range. 2) Check PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode such as disabling a feature or changing the meaning of the parameter. 3) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
